name: rh-deep
description: Extended seed pack adding de_branges, xi_function, hilbert_polya, random_matrix, mollifier_moment families to expose K-lane obstruction differentiation.

entries.title: Hilbert Space of Entire Functions and the Riemann Hypothesis
entries.note: de Branges proposes a Hilbert space whose positivity conditions would force all non-trivial zeros onto the critical line; the program depends on establishing completeness of Sonin spaces, which remains unverified.
known_blockers: positivity structure requires full function-space proof
proof_obligations: establish positivity of the de Branges reproducing kernel for all admissible entire functions
prove completeness of the Sonin space associated with the zeta function
show the function-space positivity condition is equivalent to RH

entries.title: Xi Function Entire-Function Structure and Laguerre-Polya Class
entries.note: The completed zeta function xi(s) is an entire function of order one; membership in the Laguerre-Polya class (real zeros only) would imply RH, but no proof of class membership has been found.
known_blockers: entire-function constraints are necessary but not sufficient for RH
proof_obligations: show xi(s) belongs to the Laguerre-Polya class of entire functions
prove all zeros of xi are real, which is equivalent to RH
connect entire-function order constraints to the location of zeros

entries.title: Self-Adjoint Operator Conjecture and the Berry-Keating H=xp Hamiltonian
entries.note: The Hilbert-Polya program seeks a self-adjoint operator whose eigenvalues are the imaginary parts of the zeros; Berry and Keating proposed H = xp as a semi-classical candidate, but a rigorous quantum realization with the correct spectral measure has not been constructed.
known_blockers: no candidate self-adjoint operator has been rigorously constructed
spectral measure connection to zeros unproven
proof_obligations: construct a self-adjoint operator on an explicit Hilbert space with eigenvalues matching imaginary parts of Riemann zeros
prove the spectral measure of the operator is supported exactly on the imaginary parts of zeros
verify the boundary conditions of the quantized H = xp system reproduce the Selberg zeta function

entries.title: GUE Pair Correlation of Riemann Zeros (Montgomery-Odlyzko Law)
entries.note: Montgomery's pair correlation conjecture and Odlyzko's numerical computations show that zero spacings follow GUE random matrix statistics; this is strong heuristic evidence for RH but does not determine individual zero locations.
known_blockers: GUE statistics are evidence not proof
pair correlation does not determine individual zero locations
proof_obligations: prove Montgomery's pair correlation conjecture unconditionally (currently conditional on RH)
show that GUE pair correlation statistics imply all zeros lie on the critical line
derive a deterministic constraint on individual zero positions from the statistical ensemble

entries.title: Mollifier and Moment Methods: Selberg, Levinson, Conrey Density Results
entries.note: Mollifier and moment techniques have progressively increased the proven proportion of zeros on the critical line (Selberg: positive proportion, Levinson: >1/3, Conrey: >2/5); these are unconditional but fall short of 100%.
known_blockers: partial density results do not close the off-line gap
mollifier window bounds not tight enough
proof_obligations: improve the mollifier window to achieve density greater than 1/2
show that the off-critical-line complement has measure zero
combine moment estimates with zero-free regions to close the gap unconditionally
